title: The Suckening Returns: SPCX $40b Raise, Markets, Fed, Iran, Houthi's, Fear
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: SpaceX seeking ~$40B of debt for Nvidia chips is expected and par for the course; it adds volatility and competes with equities for money, but the market will absorb it.
His 'K-peak' call of ~5.27% on the 10-year stands; the slope of yields has flattened since ~Sep 27, an inflection that is bullish for stocks.
Trump has the luxury of time; expects a deal announcement ~Oct 20-27, before the Oct 28 Fed meeting and the election, bringing gas prices down.
Low breadth is driven by Jackson Hole hawkishness and yields, not oil; agrees with Mike Wilson that breadth should catch up and yields and stocks can improve together.
Kevin Warsh as Fed chair is bearish for gold; October Fed expected to hold (Kalshi ~82%).
Critical: says it is pitched as health/education/food but 90% goes to health; drives billionaires out of state.

calls.condition: Bullish especially if the 10-year yield comes down; deal with Iran within ~20 days.
calls.reason: Qs only down ~0.6% on the SpaceX debt news and holding well above his 748 line; yield acceleration has stopped and an Iran deal is coming.
calls.quote: This is a nothing burger. And this is a really bullish setup especially if that 10 comes down.

calls.reason: Breadth at its weakest since the dot-com bubble should reverse as bond hawkishness fades; yields down and stocks up together still ahead.
calls.quote: I still think even where we sit now, a lot of that is ahead of us, not behind us.

calls.reason: Maintains his ~5.27% peak-yield call; slope of yields flattening since ~Sep 27; Wilson sees bond market overly hawkish.
calls.quote: I still maintain that around this level. I call 527 peak treasury yields.

calls.reason: Called the gold top on Jan 30; Kevin Warsh as Fed chair is bearish for gold and he expects that to continue.
calls.quote: the choice of Kevin Warsh for Fed chair is bearish for gold. And I think that'll continue to be case.

calls.condition: If a US-Iran deal is announced ~Oct 20-27 as he expects.
calls.reason: Expects Trump to strike an Iran deal in the final weeks before the election to bring gas prices down.
calls.quote: That's the target window for striking a deal... Ideal time frame for gas prices to fall before the election

calls.reason: Convergence/compression with barcoding sets up for a breakout.
calls.quote: this right here I think sets up for a beautiful breakout on nebias
